# AskBodhi

> AskBodhi (askbodhi.ai) is an AI-first growth partner for Dutch SMEs, a trade name of 64 B.V. in Hilversum, the Netherlands. It finds where a company loses money and time and fixes it in a fixed order: findability in Google and AI assistants (SEO, GEO, SEA), a client-owned digital colleague called the Bodhi Engine, and cutting work that adds no value (process optimisation with AI).

Key facts:
- Market: small and mid-sized companies in the Netherlands, often without their own marketing or IT team. Website in Dutch and English.
- Order of work: months 1–6 search and AI findability; from month 7 the Bodhi Engine; then process optimisation once growth is proven.
- Terms: nine-month term with a written-notice exit after three months. Partnerships from approx. €2,450 a month excl. VAT.
- The client owns the Bodhi Engine, its content and its data. AskBodhi sells no software licences.
- Not offered: standalone audits, ad management on its own, social media, logo design, one-off articles.
